scope: Native pinned estimator cores through external replay adapters; not the partial Modelica ports or complete flight firmware
limitations: Synthetic body-velocity/range flow interface; no real image angular noise, texture loss, or gyro/image correlation
Native active flags are not accepted-measurement counters
Native filters receive the common declared stationary flight phase; ESKF has no equivalent explicit at-rest input
PX4 health interval shortened to one second; startup local origin is explicitly initialized
ArduPilot source configuration fuses horizontal GPS/flow velocity and barometric height; vertical GPS velocity is disabled
Zero configured transport latency; no delayed arrival, jitter, magnetic disturbance, or range dropout campaign
Noise tuning and startup priors remain stack-specific; this is an as-configured comparison
Native adapters do not honor missing/invalid GPS velocity flags yet; all reviewed captures have valid three-axis GPS velocity. Fix or reject those inputs before an invalid-velocity campaign.
